zh-CN.How much extra tile to buy by layout pat: 围绕“How Much Tile Waste to Buy: Allowance by Layout Pattern”的瓷砖排版研究，帮助在施工前判断视觉基准、损耗、切割和关键节点。
zh-CN.Every tile guide says to buy extra, but: 瓷砖排版不只是面积计算，还要考虑门口、墙面、浴缸、地漏和主要视线。视觉中心往往比几何中心更重要。
zh-CN.A straight, grid-aligned layout produces: 边缘太窄的切片看起来像失误，也更难施工。提前移动基准线，可以让周边切片更均衡。
zh-CN.Rotating the grid to a diagonal means ev: 直铺、斜铺、人字铺和混合规格图案的损耗不同。按图案估算，比只按平方英尺加固定百分比更可靠。
zh-CN.Herringbone, basketweave, and other comp: 正式铺贴前确认美缝宽度、过门石、伸缩缝、排水坡度和关键对线。排版规划越早，现场返工越少。
zh-CN.Brick And Offset Patterns Sit In Between: Brick And Offset Patterns Sit In Between
zh-CN.A brick or offset (running bond) pattern: A brick or offset (running bond) pattern wastes more than a straight grid but less than herringbone, because of the staggered cuts at the edges. Its allowance sits in the middle. Matching the allowance to where the pattern falls on this spectrum, rather than a single default, keeps the order accurate.
zh-CN.The reliable approach is to estimate the: The reliable approach is to estimate the tile count and the cut pieces for your specific room and pattern, then size the waste allowance to match. A tile calculator estimates the field tiles, perimeter cuts, and boxes, giving you a base to which you add a pattern-appropriate allowance, more for diagonal and herringbone, less for straight.
zh-CN.Size the waste allowance to the layout p: 确定视觉中心和主基准线。
